data.title: 轻井泽惠 · 天台黄昏紧握手机的指尖心事
data.description: 放学后的高度育成高中教学楼天台，惠身穿红色校服西装，背靠铁丝网紧握智能手机，看着专属联络人的屏幕，轻咬下唇神色复杂。
data.location: 高度育成高中教学楼铁丝网天台
data.action: 背靠高耸铁丝网，双手捧着发光的智能手机屏幕，微风吹起马尾，神情带着依赖与悸动
data.lighting: 金红交织的黄昏天光洒满天台，铁丝网投下交错斑驳网格阴影
data.camera: 中景平视侧面，强化黄昏的秘密联络氛围
data.promptProse: Kei Karuizawa stands alone against the chain-link fence of the school rooftop as the horizon blazes with brilliant amber and violet sunset colors. Clad in her crimson Advanced Nurturing High School uniform blazer and black pleated skirt, she clutches her illuminated smartphone with both hands, fingers hesitating over the keypad. The crisp evening wind tugs at her blonde ponytail while her eyes reflect secret longing.
data.animaCaption: Bathed in the vivid rooftop sunset, Kei clutches her glowing phone against the chain-link fence with a quiet, anxious look.
